name: Student Volunteer at PAMF Palo Alto Center (Volunteer On Demand)
org: Sutter Health, Palo Alto Medical Foundation (PAMF)
city: Palo Alto, CA (795 El Camino Real)
what_you_do: You greet patients and work at the front desk. You help people find their way and help with wheelchairs. You help patients feel at ease with small acts of kindness, like a cup of water.
who_can_apply: Age 16 and older. No school or residency rule is stated.
duration: Weekday 4-hour shifts (8 am to 12 pm or 12 pm to 4 pm)
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The listing said Actively recruiting on 2026-10-16.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply now link on the page. Questions? Email pamfpeninsulaadmin@sutterhealth.org.
notes: Read on the official Sutter Health listing on 2026-10-16. This is an outpatient medical center, not a hospital. Shifts are Monday to Friday only, 8 am to 12 pm or 12 pm to 4 pm, with no weekend hours, so it fits summer or students with free weekday time. The listing does not state a minimum commitment, health screening, TB test or fees.
